headline_fact: On August 11, 2026, President Trump announced a further 90-day pause on raising the reciprocal tariff on Chinese goods to 125%; separately, a new 12.5% Section 301 tariff took effect July 24, 2026 over China's failure to enforce a forced-labor import ban, pushing the effective US tariff rate on many Chinese goods to close to 30% -- the highest of any country.
narration_script: President Trump has announced a further pause on increasing tariffs on Chinese goods to 125%, while new Section 301 tariffs took effect at 12.5% for China's non-compliance with forced labor import ban, pushing overall US tariffs close to 30%.
